Agendas

  • Heighten the romantic and extraordinary character of telenovelas.

  • Make the characters' lives unpredictable and explosive.

  • Play to find out what happens.

Principles

  • Film every scene like a telenovela.

  • Give weight to social status.

  • Address the characters, not the players.

  • Make an MC move, but don't name it.

  • Reward cruelty in the short term; reward kindness in the long term.

  • Be a fan of the PCs.

  • Destabilize the PCs when they think they're safe.

  • Never fix the truth in place; let the story evolve.

  • Don't draw straight lines in romantic relationships, but tangled webs.

  • Intertwine public life and private life.

  • Dangle temptations of every kind.

  • Sometimes, give up making the decisions.

Moves

  • Inflict a condition.

  • Make a moment romantic.

  • Put rivals face to face.

  • Reveal a terrible secret.

  • Reveal a hidden complication to the public.

  • Put a PC in a difficult situation.

  • Offer an easy way out at a price.

  • Turn a PC's move back on them.

  • Announce an upcoming reversal of fortune.

  • Demand they play their role.

  • Make a move from a character playbook or playset.

  • After every move, ask "What do you do?"

La Belleza

Are you the center of attention?

  • Hold her to an impossibly high standard.

  • Make serious matters go over her head.

  • Put a rejected suitor back in play.

  • Air her dirty laundry in public.

  • Offer her conditional love.

El Caballero

Are you handling things straightforwardly and without guile?

  • Throw him into a physical altercation.

  • Bring up his past.

  • Send him down an obviously dangerous path.

  • Challenge him when propriety demands he know how to behave.

  • Show him the consequences of using violence.

La Doña

Are you keeping your hands clean?

  • Add a complication to a scheme.

  • Threaten a loved one.

  • Ask her to solve a problem on an NPC's behalf.

  • Reveal her schemes.

  • Offer her a gift, but with strings attached.

La Empleada

Are you in over your head?

  • Turn up the romance a notch.

  • Highlight her finest qualities or her worst flaws.

  • Bring a Suitor into the scene.

  • Show what a fulfilling romantic relationship looks like.

  • Make her the center of attention.

Conditions and NPCs


NPCs do not have conditions.

  • If an NPC would mark a condition, they feel a strong emotion and react vehemently instead. The MC plays one of their moves.

  • When an NPC would clear a condition, they display a form of relief or happiness and react with gratitude.
